name: joshghent-skills
description: Nine product engineering skills in one plugin: blogger (commits → marketing content), design-review (UI critique), sentinel (repo risk audit), warden (production-error-driven dependency patching), beacon (SEO + GEO / AI-answer visibility), conductor (merge the PR queue and ship it live), growth-review (weekly numbers to one shipped improvement), gantarr (plan → importable Gantt timeline), and groundwork (local dev readiness from a fresh clone).
